summary: Star Bulk Carriers Corp., a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 4, 2026, containing a press release and information statement regarding an equity offering of new common registered voting shares and the parallel listing of all existing and new shares on Euronext Athens. The filing incorporates these exhibits by reference into existing Form F-3 and S-8 registration statements. The transaction is an ordinary equity capital raise and listing admission, not a special situation such as a rights offering or going-private. No deal terms, advisor, or premium were disclosed. What to watch: completion of the offering and listing on the Athens exchange.
